name: Gunslinger Core
description: 1.0 trainer firearm shell: Solenne (+80% Attack if all species unique), Frostplume reload, Nyafia shotgun amp, Orserk bullet-ramp on the active Pal, Xenolord for armed Partner Skills.

name: Energy Gunner
description: Same Solenne / Frostplume / Orserk shell as Gunslinger, but Xenogard replaces Nyafia for energy weapons. Keep every species unique so Solenne stays active.

name: Gobfin Weapon Stack
description: Angry Shark still stacks in 1.0 — four Gobfin (or Ignis mix) plus a mount infusion (Chillet/Orserk) for player-weapon boss melts. Best pure trainer-damage alternative to Solenne parties.

name: Orserk Pal Nuke
description: Core Pal-damage shell: Orserk ramps Attack/Defense on the active Pal from bullet hits (up to +150%), Jormuntide Ignis carries, Solenne buffs the trainer lane, Lyleen heals, Jetragon covers mobility / Dragon.

name: Blind Status Shell
description: Venusa applies Blind on your hits; Roujay punishes Blinded targets (+50–65% damage). Orserk ramps the active Pal, Celesdir Noct is the high-risk Attack amp (pair with Immortality), Astegon carries heavy skills.

name: Libero Raid Lead
description: Bellanoir Libero as the active nuke with Orserk stacks, Solenne trainer Attack (unique species), Lyleen sustain, and Frostallion for Ice coverage on Dragon threats.

name: Knocklem Ignis Wall
description: Knocklem Ignis Iron Guardian Mode (+210% Atk/Def at rank 5) for long raids — Orserk still ramps the active slot, Solenne for trainer Attack, Lyleen heals, Jetragon for repositioning.

name: Ice vs Dragon
description: Frostallion lead for Dragon bosses (Xenolord, etc.) with Cryolinx support, Orserk stacks, Solenne unique-species Attack, and Lyleen for sustain.

name: Neptilius Fire Counter
description: Neptilius as the Water carry for Fire threats (Blazamut Ryu phase 1). Orserk ramps, Solenne buffs, Lyleen sustains, Anubis covers Earth utility / swaps.

name: Selyne Mount DPS
description: Selyne mounted Dark/Neutral boost for Dark-weak bosses and typeless checks. Pair with Orserk ramp, Solenne (unique species), Lyleen, and a flexible DPS swap slot.

name: World Tree Key
description: Panthalus opens the World Tree barrier — keep a flyer and a healer ready for the endgame route.

name: Fishing Build
description: Water party with fishing boosts for lunker hunting along the coast.

name: Loot Farmer
description: Drop-rate and ranch helpers for sphere materials, ore, and gold while surveying.

name: Pack Mule
description: Stacked carry weight for long survey and hauling runs.

name: Status Punisher (Legacy)
description: Pre-1.0 blind shell using Vanwyrm Cryst + Shadowbeak. Prefer Blind Status Shell (Venusa + Roujay + Celesdir Noct) for current partner-skill data.

name: Knocklem Wall (Legacy)
description: Earth Knocklem bruiser party. Prefer Knocklem Ignis Wall — Iron Guardian Mode is the stronger 1.0 raid tank skill.

name: Energy Gunner (Legacy)
description: Older energy party without Solenne / Frostplume trainer buffs. Prefer the updated Energy Gunner or Gunslinger Core.
